# src/runtime/xr-runtime-parts.ts

<!-- Generated by scripts/document-code.mjs. Edit source contracts, then regenerate. -->

[Source](../../../../src/runtime/xr-runtime-parts.ts)

The XR half of `GameRuntime`, loaded on demand (`GameRuntime.loadXR()`), so a desktop page
does not download or parse the headset code: session, hands, calibration, motorcycle and
forklift grips, wheel grab and the weapon loadout.

## Module dependencies

- `./xr.js`
- `./xr-motorcycle.js`
- `./xr-forklift.js`
- `./xr-loadout.js`
- `./xr-grab.js`
- `./xr-splash.js`

This module contains declarations, data or re-exports; it defines no executable functions.
